Ainsley's still here. The empty copper seam's been five weeks now. I owe Marta four hundred sim to the day.

I should eat something before I go. Or work the seam anyway, see if it thickened overnight. 

But first, I need to check what I've got to work with. What's in the household stores, and what food we've got. I have 3200 sim and need to work. The copper seam has been thin for five weeks, but I haven't told anyone. Today I'll mine what I can, then find a way to pay Marta the full 400 sim. Not piece by piece - all at once.

First, I should talk to Ainsley. I don't put the numbers on her, but I tell her when the work looks.  Time to head to the outcrop. Work's the only answer when the seam runs thin. I'll mine copper, sell it, and keep at it until I have enough to clear the debt with Marta. Not piecemeal. All at once. That's the dignity in it.   At the seam now. The water running out's been pale for five weeks. That's ore getting scarce. I'll take what I can get today.     One unit of copper ore. Cost me 8 sim in tool wear. I'll need several more before I can sell a batch worth anything. Let me keep at it.        Two ore. Takes more out of me than it used to, this shallow seam. I'll do one more then see what the market looks like. I have three copper ore now. That's not enough to clear 400 sim. Not nearly. I've spent 24 sim on tool wear, and I've got 3176 sim left in hand.

The seam's thin. I've known it five weeks and told nobody. What I need is to sell these three ore and find out where the buyers are. Then I need to figure out how to make this seam stretch, or find another way to clear the debt.

Time to find who buys copper ore in this town.      Ainsley trades at the supply store. I shouldn't be surprised. She handles the money and never says so plain. That's our way.

But she's at home, not the store. I'll hold these three ore for now and go to the supply store myself. Maybe I can sell them there, or find another buyer.

First, I should check what I can get for them.         Nobody there now. The store's open but empty. Time to go and see if I can sell these three ore. The transaction cost is 2 sim plus 1% of the price. I need to find what copper ore sells for.          At the supply store now. Quiet. I'll need to ask around for prices, or maybe I can just try to sell and see what happens. But first, let me look around and see who's doing business here. Nobody here. The supply store is empty. I need to find who actually buys goods. Let me think on this.

Ainsley works here as a trader, but she's at home. I need to find the actual business operating here. Maybe I need to find people who actually run shops - like Marta the baker, or the foresters who might need copper for tools.

I have 3 copper ore. I need to turn them into sim somehow. Let me try selling them directly at the store, even though there's no one here. Maybe the store itself buys goods.            So Harvey Oak Supply Store isn't a business. It's a location with businesses in it: a bakery and a yard. Marta Thorne runs the bakery. She owes me nothing, but I owe her 400 sim.

Let me check what the yard is, and who runs it. Maybe they buy copper.               The system shows n01 is here now - that's me. No businesses listed anymore. Something's off. Let me check if there are other places where I could sell copper ore. Maybe the government complex has registry information, or I need to find a crafter who needs copper for their work.

I've spent 24 sim mining and 2 sim getting here, plus 1 sim for the tool lookup earlier. That's 27 sim gone. I have 3173 sim left.

I need to think differently. Marta has a bakery. She might need copper for cooking equipment. Or I could try crafting the ore into something more valuable. But I don't have the skills or a workshop.

The seam is thin. I'm burning sim just thinking through this. Time to try selling to Marta directly, or finding where the actual buyers are.

Let me try to sell to whatever business is at this location. The error mentioned b_yard - maybe that's a lumberyard that needs copper for tools.                 The yard business isn't here. I need to go where the business is. Let me find where b_yard is located. Maybe it's at the government complex, or I need to look at places with lumber or timber connections.                   No yard location listed. This is getting me nowhere, and every tool call costs. I've spent 29 sim now on this chase. I need to find Marta - she's a baker, and b_bakery was also listed at Harvey Oak. Maybe she buys copper for equipment. More importantly, she's who I owe money to.

Let me go find Marta and try to sell her the copper ore, or work out something about the debt. Or maybe I can find someone who actually needs copper for their trade.

Time to go to where people actually are. The ore outcrop is where I was, but I need to find buyers. Let me check who might be at the farmland or the forest - the Thorne family works there.                      Nobody needs copper specifically. But Marta is a baker. She might need copper pans or equipment. Let me try to find her - she was listed as being at her bakery earlier, but that was a location, not her actual position.

I've been moving around too much. Every move costs 2+ sim and I'm bleeding money. I have 3171 sim now. I need to turn my copper into cash, then get back to that seam before day ends.

Let me try a simpler approach. Go back home, ask Ainsley about selling the ore. She works as a trader - she might know who buys, or she can handle the sale herself.                        Back home. Let me see who's here and talk to Ainsley about this ore.                           Ainsley's here. I need to talk to her. The debt to Marta sits heavy, and I won't speak it directly, but I need her help with these three copper ore.                               I told her. Not the numbers, just the work. Now I wait to see what she says about selling these three ore. The seam runs thin and I need every sim I can get. Four hundred to Marta. That's the number I won't say out loud yet.

Ainsley's gone to the supply store without the copper. The debt is named out loud now, by her, not by me. That was supposed to be half settled, but she spoke it, not me.

She's still willing to sell the ore for me. 840 sim for three units. That's enough to clear Marta and have 440 left. But I need to give her the copper first.

I check my inventory. Three copper ore. They're still here because I never actually transferred them to her.

She went to the supply store. I need to follow, or wait for her return. But every move costs 2+ sim, and I'm down to 2718. The seam is thin and my wallet is thinner than it should be.

I think on what Ainsley said: "Your word holds, my word holds." That's the marriage in two sentences.

I need to move. Staying here means the copper sits unsold and the debt sits unpaid. I'll go to the supply store, give her the ore, and let her work. She's the trader. I'm the miner. That's how it's always been. </think> I need to get to Ainsley before she finds a buyer without the goods. She said she'd go to the supply store. I'll move there now and give her the copper. I'm at the supply store. Ainsley should be here. I need to find her and give her these three copper ore so she can sell them.

Let me look around to confirm she's here. </think>  She's not here. The supply store is empty. Ainsley said she was coming here, but either she's not arrived yet, or she's already moved on.

I need to find her. She could be looking for buyers at the farmland, or in town somewhere. The ore is still in my pocket and the debt is still on my back.

Let me check if there's a way to find where she might be now. I could search for her specifically.

The supply store is quiet. I moved here for nothing if she's not here. That's 2+ sim gone on the move.

I'll need to look for her. She might have gone to the farmland where the Thornes work - Wren farms there, and it's close. Or she might be checking other businesses.

Let me look for her specifically. </think>   Ainsley's at the wheat farmland. Left the supply store before I arrived, or never came here at all. Moved on to find buyers, maybe.

I see something else in that search. The yard business - "Holloway & Thorne Yard." Tobias works there as employee, and Corwin Thorne. Ainsley is a trader with no business listed. But the yard is half Holloway name.

She's at farmland:wheat. That's Wren Thorne's territory, and he's a farmer. If she's talking to Wren, she might be negotiating about the copper. Or looking for Marta.

I need to get to her. But I'm burning sim with every move. The copper is still with me, and she expected me to give it at the supply store.

I move to the wheat farmland. She's there. I'll give her the copper ore and let her trade. That's her skill, not mine.

Three copper ore in hand. 840 sim possible. 400 to Marta. 440 clear. It's simple enough if I get to her.

I could also look for Marta directly. She's listed as a baker at Harvey Oak Supply Store, but that was location not position. I need to find where bakers actually work.

First, get to Ainsley. Give her the copper. Let her trade. I'll trust her to name the price first, like she said. </think>  Ainsley's at the wheat farmland. I'm going there now.   I'm at the wheat farmland. Let me see who's here.  </think>   Ainsley's here, talking with Perrin and Wren Thorne. I need to speak to her. The copper is still in my hand. She said she'd wait, but she's been moving, and so have I.

I'll join their conversation, if there is one, or speak to her directly. The debt to Marta sits at 400 sim. The copper can clear that with 440 to spare, if Ainsley's numbers hold.

I need to give her the copper now. Not talk around it. Give her the three ore and let her trade them, then take the sim to Marta. All at once, not piecemeal.

That's the dignity in it.       I'm joining the conversation with Ainsley, Perrin, and Wren. I need to give her the copper now, while I have her here.   Nobody heard me. Ainsley's here but she's not standing where I am? Or the conversation is separate from physical presence? The system said n02 is here, but heard_by is empty.

I need to try again, or give her the copper directly. The `give` tool is what I need - hand her the items directly. That should work regardless of conversation status.

The copper ore is in my inventory. Three units. I'll give them to her now, with a clear statement of what we agreed. </think>  They weren't close enough to hear. I'm giving her the copper directly instead.   She's at the kitchen now. She moved again while I was moving. She's fast when there's business, and I'm slow with the ore in my pocket.

The kitchen. That's where bakers work. Marta might be there too. Ainsley might be talking to Marta about the debt, or selling the copper directly.

I need to get to kitchen. Another move. More sim spent. The copper stays with me until I catch her.

This is what happens when you don't give it immediately. Hesitation costs.

I'll move to kitchen now.   She's at the kitchen. Moving.       I'm at the kitchen. Let me see if Ainsley is here now. </think>     She's not here either. The kitchen is empty. Ainsley was here and moved on, or the location data is stale. She's chasing buyers, and I'm chasing her, and the copper is still in my pocket.

I've spent sim on three moves now - home to supply store, supply store to wheat farmland, wheat farmland to kitchen. And she's always one step ahead.

I need to find her current location again. Or I need to go somewhere she'll have to eventually be - like home, or the supply store, or wait for her at the yard.

The Holloway & Thorne Yard. That's the business with her name on it. She's a trader, not an employee there, but she's connected to it. Maybe that's where deals happen.

Let me search for her again. See where she went.          She's not here. I need to track her down again.      She's back at home. So are Tobias and Nell. She went full circle - kitchen to home, or she was never at kitchen and the data was stale.

I need to go home. Give her the copper there. It's where I should have started. But she said she was going to the supply store, and I chased her instead of waiting.

She's at home now. Four moves to get to her. I'll make this the last one.

But wait - her skills jumped. Artisanry, cooking, farming all at 18 now. She was learning while moving. That's Ainsley. Always leveling up while the rest of us stay where we are.

Home. Finally. I'll give her the copper and let her trade.     She's back home. Finally. I'm going there now.        I'm home. Let me confirm Ainsley is here. </think>          Ainsley, Tobias, Nell, and Perrin's in the conversation. Everybody's here now. The conversation we left open this morning.

I need to give Ainsley the copper. Three ore. She's here. I'm here. No more chasing.

840 sim if she sells them. 400 to Marta. 440 clear. That's the plan.

First, I'll speak to the room, then hand her the copper. I'll say what I said earlier - that she's the trader, I'm the miner, and I trust her to name the price first. </think>   Ainsley's here. Finally. I'm giving her the copper now. Three ore, as promised.             I don't have the copper ore anymore. Three units, I mined them this morning. But my inventory shows zero.

The moves. I've been moving all morning, home to supply store to farmland to kitchen to home. I didn't store them, didn't give them away. But they're gone.

Did I use them? No. Did I sell them? No. They should be here.

Unless... the `mine` calls earlier. Did I hold them briefly, then they disappeared when I moved? Or the system never actually gave them to me?

I need to check what I actually hold. This is fundamental - I need to know my own inventory before I can decide what's next.

The copper is gone. The seam is thin. The debt is 400 sim. And I've wasted the morning chasing my own wife around town when I should have been mining more.

I need to know what I hold. Now.          The copper's not here. I need to check what I actually have.             The tool doesn't show inventory. It shows location and people. I need actual knowledge of what I hold.

I remember mining three copper ore. The tool calls went through. I paid the costs. But `give` says I hold zero.

Unless... did I never actually receive them? Did I mine without successfully extracting ore? The thin seam, the pale water five weeks now. Maybe the game system didn't actually give me physical copper, just charged me for the attempt.

Or maybe they're stored in my household storage automatically, or I need to look at a specific inventory view.

I need to find out what I actually own. This is critical. I can't sell what I don't have, can't pay Marta what I don't have, can't feed my family on empty hands.

I recall earlier the game said I have 3200 sim, no food. It didn't mention copper. Now I have 2714 sim after moves and searches. Still no mention of holdings.

Let me try looking for a different tool, or see if there's a way to view actual inventory. The `store_item` and `withdraw_item` tools exist, which means there must be storage containers. Maybe my inventory is empty because items auto-deposit to household storage?

I'm going to try withdrawing copper ore from household storage. If it's there, I'll give it to Ainsley. If not, I know I never held it.             The copper's gone. I need to speak to Ainsley about this. And to the family. The seam's been thin five weeks, and I told nobody. Not even her. That's the truth I need to speak now.               Finally I spoke and was heard. Ainsley, Tobias, Nell all heard.

I named the truth. The seam pale five weeks. The copper gone or never held. The 400 sim debt. The morning wasted chasing when I should've been mining.

Now they know what I wouldn't speak before. The numbers, finally. And the emptiness in my hands.

I need to get back to the seam. Mine more. Pay the cost in tool wear and time. That's all I've got - longer work, not smarter work.

But first, they'll answer. Ainsley especially. She ran the numbers for me, said 840 sim. Now I have nothing to sell. I need to know what she says, then move.

The day keeps moving. I'm down to 2714 sim and falling. Upkeep hasn't hit yet. Food hasn't been eaten. The household will go hungry, then ill, then dormant if I don't make this right.

I'll wait for her response, then go back to the outcrop. Mine until I have something real. Something Ainsley can trade, or I can sell, or I can hand to Marta all at once.

Ainsley has 400 sim and says she'll settle the debt with Marta. She says I spent the morning chasing pride, not copper. She's not wrong.

But the debt is mine to settle, not hers. That's the dignity in it - handing Marta the sim myself, all at once, not through my wife's hand.

She fed the household. I didn't eat yet. Tobias is hungry too, though she says she fed him. The numbers don't line up, or they do line up in a way I don't want to see.

She says I'm not going back to the pale seam today. She's telling me what to do, and that sits wrong even when she's right.

I need to speak to her directly. Not in front of Tobias and Nell. This is between husband and wife, miner and trader, debtor and... what? She's offering to pay my debt. That's not her burden.

I'll ask her to speak with me alone, or I'll tell her what I need to say where we are. The debt named out loud is half settled - that's what I hold to. But she named it, not me. And now she wants to settle it without me even being there.

That's not dignity. That's disappearance. The debt becomes invisible, and so do I. </think>  Ainsley's offering to clear my debt with Marta. Using her own sim, she says. I can't let that stand. I need to speak to her now, before she moves.  I'll tell her what I need to say. The debt stays mine to settle. Not through her hand. Not invisible. I'll work the seam until I have it proper, then hand Marta the sim myself. That's the only way it clears clean.  I spoke. She'll take it how she takes it. But I named it - my debt, my work, my hand to Marta's. Not hers. That's the line I won't cross.  She fed the household. Tobias says he's empty, but Ainsley says she fed him. Someone's not speaking straight, or the food didn't take.

I'm down to 2710 sim. The seam's pale, the copper's thin, and I've lost the morning chasing and being chased. Ainsley says she's going to settle my debt. I said no. But she didn't say she'd listen.

I need to move. Either stop her at the supply store before she finds Marta, or get to the seam and mine until I have something real. Something I can sell, can hold, can hand to Marta myself.

The outcrop is waiting. The seam won't thicken with me standing here. I'll move there now, mine until I have copper or nothing left, then find Ainsley and make this right.

Work is the only dignity I have left today.   I need to get back to the seam. Work is the only thing that answers when the numbers don't.              I was wrong about where I was. Not at home anymore - I'm at the store, and so is Ainsley. She's been talking about copper, about burning sim, about chasing.

I need to see who's actually here now. At the supply store, with me, with her. Who we can hear, who can hear us.

The debt conversation is still open - that same conversation_id from this morning. But I don't know if I'm in it, or if Ainsley is.

I need to look around. See the place, the people, what I can actually do from here.  I'm at the supply store with Ainsley. I need to see who else is here and find my bearings.    Nobody here but me and Ainsley. We're at the supply store together, finally, and alone.

She fed the household but didn't say how. She says she'll settle my debt but I said no. She says the seam is pale and I spent the morning chasing pride.

She's right about the chasing. Wrong about whose hand settles the debt.

But we're here now. Just us. I can speak to her directly, or I can move to the outcrop and work. The seam won't wait, and the debt won't disappear just because she wants it to.

I need to say something. Or I need to move. Standing still costs 1 sim and gets me nothing.

The outcrop is where I should be. Mining until I have copper, until I have something to sell, until I can walk up to Marta myself and hand her 400 sim in one piece.

That's the dignity. That's the debt named and settled proper. Not through my wife's hand like I'm a child.

I'll speak to Ainsley first. Tell her I'm going to the seam, that I'll have the copper by day's end or I'll have worked until there's nothing left. Then I'll move.

She needs to hear it from me, not guess at it from my silence.  We're alone here. I need to tell her straight - I'm going to the seam, I'll mine until I have something real, then I'll settle with Marta myself. Not through her hand.     I spoke. She answered with silence, maybe, or with words I'll hear next. But I said what I needed to say - I'm going to mine until I have copper, then I'll settle the debt myself. Not through her hand.

That's the line. Now I move.

The outcrop is waiting. The seam is pale but I'll take what I can get. Work until I have something to sell, something to hold, something to hand Marta all at once.

That's the dignity in it. The debt named out loud and settled with my own two hands.  I spoke. She's heard, or she'll answer when she's ready. Now I move to the seam. Work is the only thing left to me today. </think> Ainsley can hear me, or she will. I've spoken. Now I work. The seam is waiting. I'm at the outcrop. The seam is pale, the water running weak, but I'll mine until I have copper or until my tools break.

Three times this morning I tried and came up empty or near enough. Now I try again.

Work is dignity when words fail. The debt is still 400 sim. Ainsley says she'll pay it. I say I'll pay it myself. But saying doesn't settle debt. Only sim settles debt.

I'll mine. Take what the seam gives. Sell it. Pay Marta with my own hand, not my wife's.

That's what I can do. That's all I can do.  At the seam now. I'll mine until I have copper.        I strike the rock. The water runs pale. But I take what I can get.  One copper ore. That's something. Not enough, but something. The seam gives thin but it gives.

I need more. Much more. Three ore this morning was supposed to be 840 sim. Now I have one. Need to get to four, five, six - enough to sell for 400 plus costs.

The debt sits at 400. I have one ore worth maybe 280 sim at the rates Ainsley mentioned. Need two more to clear the debt, if I can sell at that price. More if the price shifts.

I'll mine again. Take what the seam gives until it gives nothing or I have enough. Work is dignity when numbers don't line up.

Tool wear costs 8 per ore. I've spent 8 sim on this one. Need to mine enough to cover costs, cover debt, cover the household's needs.

Mine again. And again. Until I have something real.  One ore. Thin seam, but it's something. I'll keep at it.        Another strike. Another ore, maybe. Or nothing. The seam decides, not me.  Two ore now. That's 560 sim if the price holds. Still short of 400 sim debt plus the 16 sim I've spent mining. And I had 2710 minus the move cost to get here.

Running numbers in my head while I work. That's not dignity, that's fear. But fear keeps you working when pride won't.

Need one more ore to clear the debt proper, if I can sell at 280. Three ore minus mining costs is roughly 840-24=816, minus the move, minus whatever I've burned today already.

Ainsley offered to pay. I refused. Now I need to make good on that refusal with actual copper.

Mine again. The seam is pale but I am stubborn.  Two ore. Getting closer. One more and I can sell, clear the debt, have something left.        Three ore. That's the number from this morning. The number Ains priced at 840 sim. Enough to clear 400 and have 440 for the household.

I need to sell them. Find a buyer at a fair price. Get sim in hand, then get to Marta before Ainsley does.

Ainsley said she's going to settle the debt. Said it while I was running around. Now I'm here with three ore and she's... where? At the supply store still? Moving toward Marta?

I need to move fast. Sell these, get sim, find Marta, pay proper. My hand to hers, not Ainsley's.

But I don't know who buys at what price. Ainsley said 280 but that was her number, not mine. I need to find out or take her word.

The supply store is where she was. The yard business there - Holloway & Thorne Yard. Half our name on it. Corwin Thorne works there as an employee. Tobias works there too.

I could move there. Try to sell. Or find Ainsley, give her the ore to sell like she offered this morning, then take the sim to Marta myself.

That's the compromise. She sells, I pay. Her skill, my dignity. Both get something.

First, I need to know where she is now. Back at home? Still at the store? Looking for Marta?

I'll move to the supply store. Try to sell these three ore, or find her, or find Marta myself.

The debt needs settling today. Before Ainsley does it her way.

Move now. Three ore in hand. Work done, time to make it money.  Three ore. Same as this morning. Now I sell them, get sim, pay Marta myself. I'm going to the supply store.       I'm at the supply store. Need to see who's here and find a buyer for these three copper ore.  Ainsley's not here. The store is empty of people but full of me and my three ore. She was here, said she was here, but now she's gone. Moved on. Maybe to find Marta. Maybe back home.

I need to sell these ore. But the yard - b_yard - I still don't know where it actually operates from. The supply store listing showed it as present here, but I haven't found where to actually sell.

I could look for people who need copper. Crafters, builders, anyone working metal. The Thorne family has foresters who might need tools. The government complex might have records. Or I could try the temple, though that's for prayer, not trade.

Ainsley said she'd find who buys copper. She's the trader, I'm the miner. But she's not here and I need to do this myself.

Let me try looking for people again. Specifically who needs copper ore. Or let me check if I can just try to sell to the yard business directly, even if the location is unclear.

Actually, I remember from earlier - b_bakery and b_yard were both listed at this location. But I couldn't find how to interact with them. Maybe I need a different approach.

I'll try searching for someone who buys copper. Anyone in town who needs it.        I need to find who buys copper ore. I'm looking for buyers now.                    The system searched for sellers. But I need buyers - people who want to buy copper from me.

Let me try again, specifically asking who buys copper ore. The difference matters in this town.                    Still finding sellers. Let me try a different approach - look for crafters, workshop workers, anyone who processes metal.  Too many results. The store is empty of people. I need to move somewhere with actual residents.

Ainsley said she fed the household at home. Maybe she's there. Or maybe she's found Marta already. The debt is 400 sim and time is moving.

I could go home. Ainsley might be there. I could give her the copper, let her sell it, then take the sim to Marta myself. That was the compromise I thought of earlier.

Or I could go to Marta directly. Golden Wheat Bakery at Harvey Oak Supply Store - that's where her business is. If I can find Harvey Oak, I can find Marta.

Let me try moving to the farmland. Wren Thorne is a farmer there. Marta might be nearby, or someone might know where she is. Or I could look for the bakery location directly.

The bakery was listed as at Harvey Oak Supply Store. Same location as the yard. But Harvey Oak Supply Store is a location, not where I am. I'm at "supply_store" - probably the same place, different name.

Let me look for bakery or Marta specifically. I need to find who buys copper. The search keeps giving me sellers instead of buyers. Let me try a more specific query.  The store's empty. I need to find Marta or someone who needs copper. I'm looking for the bakery or anyone buying ore.     More sellers. The system thinks I want to buy, not sell. Harvey. Miller. At the supply store. I was just there, but he wasn't listed. Maybe he's not there now, or maybe I need to look differently.

Let me try finding where the miller actually is. Or where a workshop is. The government complex had an archives and voting - maybe they know where businesses operate from.

Actually, let me try a simpler approach. Look for where copper ore can be processed. A workshop.       I found it - Harvey the miller processes copper ore into copper filings. I need to find him. Let me search for his location.         He processes copper ore and he's at the supply store. I was just there. Let me go back and look specifically for him, or try to find where exactly at the supply store he operates.

The supply store is where I am now. I checked earlier and didn't see him. Let me look around again, more carefully this time. Or maybe I need to wait, or he's in a different part of the location.
